signaling_summary: ONFI 4.1 defines four data-interface signaling families on a common 8-bit DQ bus plus control strobes. (1) SDR (asynchronous): single-ended SSTL-class LVCMOS at VccQ (3.3 V or 1.8 V). (2) NV-DDR (source-synchronous, single-ended): single-ended bidirectional DQS strobe; CLK on the WE_n pin. (3) NV-DDR2: differential DQS_t/DQS_c; ZQ Calibration for output impedance; On-Die Termination (ODT). (4) NV-DDR3: differential DQS_t/DQS_c AND differential RE_t/RE_c; DCC / Read DQ Training / Write TX/RX DQ Training; matrix termination. Reference voltage VREFQ is used as the input threshold for NV-DDR2 and NV-DDR3 single-ended path. Internal NAND-array bit-line / sense-amp / charge-pump circuitry is highly analog but intentionally out of scope of the host-device interface specification.

differential_signals_nv_ddr2_3.name: DQS_t / DQS_c
differential_signals_nv_ddr2_3.description: Bidirectional differential data strobe. Crossing-point defines latching edge.

differential_signals_nv_ddr2_3.name: RE_t / RE_c
differential_signals_nv_ddr2_3.description: Differential Read Enable (NV-DDR3 only; optional NV-DDR2).

vref_specification.VREFQ_purpose: External voltage reference for input/output signals when NV-DDR2 or NV-DDR3 data interface is selected. Not used when SDR or NV-DDR is selected.
vref_specification.VREFQ_pin: Dedicated pin VREFQ_x (per data bus) on packages supporting NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3.

zq_calibration.purpose: Calibrates the output driver impedance against the external RZQ reference resistor (typ. 300 Ω ±1 %) connected between the ZQ pin and Vss.
zq_calibration.long_command: F9h ZQ Calibration Long — issued after Reset; tZQCL ≥ 1 µs.
zq_calibration.short_command: D9h ZQ Calibration Short — periodic, for V/T drift; tZQCS depends on timing mode.
zq_calibration.applicability: NV-DDR2 and NV-DDR3 devices supporting ZQ calibration.

on_die_termination_nv_ddr2_3.command: ODT Configure (E2h) for matrix termination; Set Features (02h or 58h) for self-termination configuration.
on_die_termination_nv_ddr2_3.purpose: Provide bus-end termination for high-speed source-synchronous signaling; reduces reflections at NV-DDR2 (800 MT/s) and NV-DDR3 (1.2 GT/s).

input_threshold_levels.NV_DDR2_3: VIH_min = VREFQ + 100 mV, VIL_max = VREFQ - 100 mV (single-ended); differential VID_min per Section 4.14.

ac_overshoot_undershoot.purpose: Section 2.11 of ONFI 4.1 specifies allowed overshoot / undershoot envelope on all input/output pins to bound EMI and prevent latch-up.
ac_overshoot_undershoot.applicability: All data interfaces; tighter envelope on NV-DDR3.

pin_capacitance.I/O_pin_capacitance: Parameter Page byte 128 (max in 0.1 pF units), bytes 150-151 (typical NV-DDR2/3).

notes: Although the device interface itself is digital, the underlying NAND array (floating-gate / charge-trap cells, bit-lines, sense amplifiers, page registers, charge pumps for high-voltage Program / Erase, on-die ADC for read margining on TLC/QLC devices) is heavily analog. ONFI 4.1 intentionally treats the array as a black box and standardizes only the host-device interface so that controllers can serve multiple vendors / generations without analog-level reverification.
